note: The Order Longbow's longbow, tier III (elite): a 42 px bow of stained wood with broad carved roots narrowing to fine tips, a gilt wire down the first three staves of each limb and a gilt cuff, long gilt-capped horns swept forward, an enamel-wound grip between gilt collars; no badge.
